guarded_ordered_transitions: Init logs title r_item_i4973, initializes cache, and presents SFrd09001: text r_item_i4974, Next and Exit.
Exit on S001 opens DL003 (r_msg_c1016): Yes emits backToUtilityMenu; No/other resolves without navigation.
Next opens buttonless DL001 (r_msg_l1013), then startExtendedSession.

startExtendedSession performs startGeneralComm({ecuId,busId}), best-effort setNegativeResponseCondition({repReqRetryMax:0}), transitSession({modeId:1}), transitSession({modeId:3}); resolves {result:true}, or catches failure into {result:false}. It does not clean communication internally.
If session start is false, dispatch endGeneralComm without awaiting, close loader, await common communication-error dialog, and stop this flow.

Otherwise getStatusFlag sends 22 91 13. Require response.resultInfo.result===0, at least seven total bytes, and (resBody[6]&0x80)!==0x80. Any failure becomes {result:false} and takes the same unawaited endGeneralComm/common-error path.

Otherwise receiveEcuData reads the four target DIDs sequentially using 22 DID-high DID-low. Each response must have resultInfo.result===0; take resBody.slice(3), then append {did:[high,low],datalength:payload.length,value:payload} to saveData. No additional minimum payload length is imposed. Partial collected data remains cached if a later request fails.

After receiveEcuData resolves, controller dispatches endExtendedSession without awaiting it. This helper best-effort transits to modeId 1, then best-effort ends general communication, and resolves {result:true}. If receive result is false, close loader and show DL005/r_msg_w1018; any button acknowledgement emits backToUtilityMenu.

On receive success, checkSavedFolder calls getSpecificFolder({folderNo:1}), requiring result 0, a defined nonempty folderInfoList and nonempty first folderInfo. Then getSettingFileInfo({fileType:2,keyList:['specificSubFolders','utilityStoreData']}) must return result 0 and fileData exactly '\MemG'; append that suffix to folderInfo.
Folder-check failure closes loader, displays DL004/r_msg_w1017, and returns to the menu on acknowledgement.

isExistSavedFile calls getFolderInformation({path:folderInfo,includeFileList:['FRD_09_SAVEFILE']}). A result-0 nonempty file list with a valid first lastUpdate yields isExistSavedFile=true and locale-formatted local date/time. Nonzero result, absent list, invalid date and request failure are swallowed; the usual return is {result:true,isExistSavedFile:false,timeStamp:''}. Thus these cases normally do not take the controller's !result branch.

Existing file: close loader and loop DL002/r_msg_c1014, with saved date prepended. Yes approves overwrite. Any other DL002 button opens DL003; Yes there declines save and returns to menu, while No/other repeats DL002.

No existing file or approved overwrite: saveEcuData builds {data:[...saveData]}, JSON deep-copies and stringifies it, encrypts the string with shared encryptAES, and invokes writeFile({path:folderInfo+'\\FRD_09_SAVEFILE',mode:1,data:encryptedString}). A resolved write is accepted without an additional numeric result test.

After writing, getFolderInformation on that folder and name must have result 0, a nonempty fileInfoList, a nonempty first lastUpdate and a valid Date. Convert local date/time via convertLocaleTime. Failure returns {result:false,timeStamp:''}, shows DL004 and returns to menu on acknowledgement, even if writing already succeeded.
Successful save logs r_item_i4978, closes loader, and shows SFrd09002: r_item_i4975 plus r_item_i4976 and saved timestamp. Exit emits backToUtilityMenu.
unit_contracts.mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics: saveData is reset only by initFrd09, not by receiveEcuData or a failed attempt. There is no Cancel button during collection/save. endExtendedSession and early endGeneralComm are deliberately not awaited by controller code. Neither exit confirmation nor dispose requests cleanup. Frd09Dialog.closeDialog closes and clears only its stored DL001 instance.
unit_contracts.user_visible_result: A successful save displays the saved date; collection failure and file/folder/write/date failures use different warning dialogs. Session/status failures use the shared communication-error dialog.
unit_contracts.native_cassette_continuation: Raw ECU frames continue through SendMessageForUtility/UG000015. Filesystem/settings calls continue through FL000007, IF000012, FL000005 and FL000002. Frontend ownership includes the exact encrypted JSON envelope and filename shared with Frd10; native crypto/file/protocol implementation is not claimed.

guarded_ordered_transitions: Init logs r_item_i4979 and presents SFrd10001/r_item_i4980 with Next and Exit. Exit opens DL002/r_msg_c1020: Yes emits backToUtilityMenu; otherwise remain.
Next opens buttonless DL001/r_msg_l1019 and calls readRecordedData.

readRecordedData gets specific folder 1, requiring result 0 and a truthy first folderInfo; reads setting {fileType:2,keyList:['specificSubFolders','utilityStoreData']}, requiring result 0 and exact fileData '\MemG'; gets folder information for folderInfo+fileData and exact filename; requires result 0 and an entry whose fileName==='FRD_09_SAVEFILE'.

For matching lastUpdate, split on /[-T:+]/. With at least six pieces, savedDate is selected by dateFormatId: 1=Y/M/D, 2=Y/D/M, 3=M/Y/D, 4=M/D/Y, 5=D/Y/M, 6=D/M/Y, each followed by space HH:mm. A short split leaves savedDate empty; unsupported dateFormatId produces undefined.

Read file at folderInfo+fileData+'\\FRD_09_SAVEFILE'; require result 0; decrypt response.apiArgs.data through shared decryptAES; JSON.parse the plaintext into cache.readData. No explicit VIN, schema, data-array size, DID uniqueness or numeric-byte validation is performed here.
Any readRecordedData failure returns {result:false,savedDate}; close loader and display DL003/r_msg_w1021. OK returns to menu; other button values resolve without navigation.

On successful read, showSFrd10Dl004 bypasses confirmation and approves immediately if savedDate is falsy. Otherwise loop DL004/r_msg_c1023 with r_msg_n1022+savedDate prepended: Yes approves; No/other opens DL002; Yes there declines and returns to menu, otherwise repeat DL004.

Approval opens DL001 and starts general communication, sets retry maximum 0 best-effort, enters default session, then extended session. Failure best-effort ends general communication and returns {result:false}; controller closes loader and shows common communication error.

writeEcuData first reads each target DID sequentially with 22 DID. Only resolved responses with resultInfo.result===0 append {did,datalength,value:resBody.slice(3)}. A resolved nonzero result neither appends nor explicitly rejects.

Compare the collected values against cache.readData.data.find(matching DID). During the first pass compare datalength; during the final pass compare JSON.stringify(value). The comparison uses forEach(async ecuData=>...), whose returned promises are not awaited. Preserve this source behavior rather than treating it as an awaited validation loop.

Read 22 AA 04 and require at least five total bytes. Save the entire response array by reference. To write irradiation-stop state, mutate that array's byte 0 to 0x2E and OR byte 4 with 0x20, then send that entire mutated array.
For each target DID in fixed order, find saved file record, wait 200 ms, and send [0x2E,DID-high,DID-low,...saved.value].
Read all four DIDs again and perform value comparisons as above.

Read 22 91 13, require at least seven bytes, retain resBody.slice(3). Clear statusFlag[3]&=0x7F and write [0x2E,0x91,0x13,...statusFlag]. Read 22 91 13 again, require at least seven bytes and bit 0x80 clear in payload byte 3.

Success performs best-effort default-session transition, best-effort endGeneralComm, then best-effort deleteFile({path:folderInfo+fileData+'\\FRD_09_SAVEFILE'}), and returns {result:true}. Deletion failure does not change success.

Any write pipeline failure performs best-effort default-session transition and endGeneralComm, returns {result:false}, and retains the backup file. There is no rollback of already-written ECU data or irradiation-stop state.
Controller closes loader. False result shows common communication error. True result logs r_item_i4982 and shows SFrd10002/r_item_i4981 with Exit returning to the utility menu.
unit_contracts.mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics: The backup is consumed only after the entire successful pipeline. The irradiation-stop bit is not restored by this frontend. No Cancel button exists during restoration. Dispose and ordinary exit confirmation do not issue cleanup.
unit_contracts.unused_but_inventoried_behavior: showSFrd10Dl005 constructs DL005/r_msg_w1024; OK/default branches only break and do not navigate. No owned callsite invokes it.
unit_contracts.native_cassette_continuation: File and settings APIs are FL000007/IF000012/FL000005/FL000001/FL000010. ECU operations use the selected ecuId/busId communication context and UG000015. Shared AES string decoding is joined to MenuShell; native algorithms remain separate.

entry_admission_input_domain.state: Controller stores unit, currentView, inputValueObj and outputValueObj. Init constructs a four-property null input object and immediately replaces it with Number(object), yielding NaN; do not describe initial inputValueObj as the original object. outputValueObj has four item/resource rows and selected unit resource. View keeps four itemInfo entries with domId,inputValue=null,mm/inch regexes and removal regexes. Worker cache.data={ecuInfo}.

input_and_dom_contract.S002: UtilityView G003, four text inputs in fields_in_order; mm unit 1 uses maxlength 4, inch/other branch maxlength 6. Next has useParam:true and starts disabled. Ordered values arrive as evt.args[1][0..3].value. Back returns S001; Exit opens the exit confirmation.
events: compositionstart sets a per-input isComposing flag.
compositionend clears it, strips characters using the unit-specific removal regex, runs convertFullWidthToHalfWidth, stores the result in itemInfo.inputValue, and recalculates Next.

input outside composition compares the original value with the format regex and restores the previous cached value on mismatch; a second branch splits the original value on '.' and may update itemInfo.inputValue even after that restoration. The no-dot/length>3 branch restores itemInfo.inputValue; it does not establish a separate effective three-digit mm maximum.
change and focusout outside composition strip invalid characters, convert full-width characters, normalize exactly '0.00'/'0.0' to '0', update cached inputValue, and recalculate Next.

allJudgeDigit enables Next only if every cached itemInfo.inputValue is nonnull, nonempty and matches the selected regex. It checks the view's cached fields, not fresh DOM values. Recreating S002 does not synchronize those cached fields from controller.inputValueObj.
input_and_dom_contract.normalization: Mm stripping removes everything except ASCII/full-width digits. Inch stripping preserves ASCII/full-width digits and '.', '．', '。'. Conversion replaces the listed dash/slash character class with '-', replaces '。' with '.', converts full-width digits/dot by subtracting 0xFEE0, and prefixes leading '.' with '0'. It splits into parts, truncates a fractional part to two characters only when parts.length===2, strips leading zeroes unless the integer part is exactly '0', and finally rejoins parts. The intermediate parts.length>2 collapse assignment is overwritten by the final parts.join('.'); do not claim that multiple dots are reliably collapsed.

guarded_ordered_transitions: Init logs r_item_i4804. S001/r_item_i4805 has Next=>S002 and Exit=>DL003. S002 uses instructions r_item_i4806/r_item_i4807, field labels r_item_i4808..i4811 and mm/inch resources r_item_i1005/i1006.

S002 Next captures the four ordered strings into a newly constructed targetData object in fields_in_order. For unit===2 only, each outgoing value is Math.round(Number(inputString)*25.4). For mm, strings remain strings until worker processing.

Before validation, controller records the original displayed values and unit in an activity-report table headed by r_item_i5087/i5088/i5089 and labeled r_item_i4814. It then opens buttonless DL001/r_msg_l0939.

checkInputData accepts inclusive mm-domain ranges: height 500..3000; distance 1000..6000; target separation 0..1500; size 0..500. JavaScript relational comparisons apply to the supplied values. Accept resolves {}; reject rejects {}.
Validation failure closes loader and shows DL002/r_msg_w0940 titled r_item_i4813. OK/other acknowledges without navigation, retaining S002.
Validation success starts the common ADAS session sequence.
Session failure invokes the worker's best-effort endGeneralComm, then controller invokes shared communication-error dialog without awaiting it and returns to S001, whose creation closes the loader.

writeTargetInformation enumerates targetData with for(var key in value). For each value, parseInt(value[key],10), convert to hexadecimal, padStart(4,'0'), and split hexadecimal text into consecutive two-character byte values. With the normal controller object this produces four unsigned big-endian 16-bit values in fields_in_order. Request is [0x2E,0x50,0x82,...bytes]. Resolved send yields {}; rejection yields rejected {}.
Write success performs common default-session/general-communication cleanup, logs r_item_i4815, closes loader, and shows S003/r_item_i4812 with Exit=>menu.
Write failure performs the same cleanup, invokes shared communication-error dialog without awaiting it, and returns to S001.
DL003/r_msg_c0941 uses literal 'Yes'/'No': Yes=>menu; No/other=>remain. It closes any loader before opening.
unit_contracts.mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics: No in-flight cancel route. Input and view caches survive Back/screen recreation according to the assignments above. Report logging precedes worker validation. Dispose does not perform session cleanup or close a loader.
unit_contracts.native_cassette_continuation: Selected ECU context starts through SC000013; policy/session calls use UG000007/UG000004; 2E 50 82 continues through UG000015. No separate security algorithm is present in these six Adas01 members.

S001 Next opens DL001/r_msg_l0942. checkWebService reads getSettingFileInfo({filePath:commonInfo.settingFileInfo.distributorDepending.countryInformation.userType.filePath,keyList:['sendCalibrationResult']}). Parse fileData as SettingType.OBJECT; first parse is defaulted to {} for id, serverId=parseInt(id,10). A second parse supplies .url directly. Accept if URL is falsy or loginMode===1. Otherwise reject. Exceptions/request failures reject.
checkWebService failure closes loader and opens DL002/r_msg_c0943. Yes resolves and reopens loader, continuing the ECU workflow. No rejects and outer catch returns to menu.
Start common ADAS session. On failure close loader, show common communication error, then return to S001 when that dialog resolves.
readCompletionFlag sends 22 11 01; require at least five bytes and byte 4&0x80 set. Set bit succeeds; absent bit rejects READERROR; short/request error rejects COMERROR.
Completion rejection first performs cleanup and closes loader. READERROR shows DL003/r_msg_w0944 whose 'Ok' returns to menu. COMERROR shows common communication error, then S001.

Read target values using common target_read. On success clean up, cache stringValueList, log a four-row Item Name/Value/Unit table labeled r_item_i4834 and headed r_item_i4819/i4820/i4821, close loader and show S002. Read failure cleans up and shows common communication error, then S001.

S002 is a nonselectable L002 table showing target values under r_item_i4822..i4825 and selected unit. Next=>S003/r_item_i4826. S003 Back=>S002. S001/S002/S003/S004 Exit=>DL004/r_msg_c0945: Yes=>menu; No=>remain.
S003 Next sets failure report result=1, opens DL001, starts common ADAS session, then sends startRequestRoutine 31 01 11 82.
Routine-start failure cleans up, sends failure calibration result, then closes loader and shows common communication error=>S001. Failure to send the result instead closes loader and emits LOGOUT.

Routine-start success closes DL001, opens cancellable DL005/r_msg_l0946, and invokes checkTargetRecognition. Poll 31 03 11 82 after 200 ms per attempt. Before every iteration, isAborted rejects ABORTED. Require at least six bytes: byte 5===2 succeeds; byte 5===3 rejects ROUTINEABORTED; other/short resolved response rejects COMERROR. Failure attempts mode1/end and rejects {result:{errorStatus,errorCode}}.

worker_process_common.Process1_skeleton: getEcuStatus({checkConnected:true,checkEcuFuncList:true}) must equal CONNECTED, then startComm, negative-condition setup, mode1, mode3, ordered support checks. worker_process_common.Process2_skeleton: Initialize modeTransitionFlag0,errorCode='-'; startComm,negative-condition setup,mode1,mode3, family-specific activation/confirmation. worker_process_common.Process3_skeleton: Initialize resultFlag0,adjustmentStatus0,errorCode='-',defaultSession=true. startComm,negative-condition setup,read22 F1 86 requiring length>=4 and byte3===03. Any failure in that initial chain attempts mode1 then mode3 without restarting communication. Then family-specific status/error/completion checks. Any later rejection sets resultFlag3. Attempt mode1(ignore=true) only if defaultSession remains true, then endComm; return result:true and family fields. Incomplete cases deliberately retain extended session by setting defaultSession=false, although endGeneralComm still runs.
worker_process_common.Process4_skeleton: startComm,negative-condition setup,mode1,mode3,read family mode DID, conditionally clear bit by response-copy write. Swallow failure of that main chain, then mode1(ignore=true),endComm; return {result:true}.

frd: 22 A1 90: length>=12; byte5 must contain40,20,10 and byte11 must contain80.
adas: 22 A1 11: length>=5; byte3&02 and byte3&01 and byte4&20 nonzero.
fsrrsr_for_each_selected_side_identity: 22 90 34, then22 90 35, then22 91 12, then22 91 14: each length>=6 and byte5&80 nonzero.

frd.activate: Read22 91 20,length>=7. If byte6&80 is clear, clone the entire resBody, replace byte0 with2E, set byte6=resBody[6]|80 and send the full cloned array; otherwise skip writing.
frd.confirm_loop: Each iteration waits200ms, reads22 90 12,length>=6, initializes startTime after first valid response. byte5===06 -> flag1. Otherwise read22 90 13,length>=6; err=(byte5>>3)&1F. Nonzero -> flag2,errorCode=String(err). Otherwise elapsed>=10000ms rejects -> outer flag3; otherwise repeat. No explicit iteration limit.

adas.activate: Read22 50 84,length>=5. Existing byte4&80 -> flag1. Otherwise clone entire resBody, byte0=2E,byte4|=80,send. Write success -> flag1.
adas.write_failure: Read22 11 0A,length>=5. supportBits=byte3,errBits=byte4. For indices0..4, if both contain80>>index, append codes31,32,33,34,35 in order, joined ', '. Nonempty code string -> flag2,errorCode=string; empty -> reject -> flag3. No confirmation polling loop.

fsrrsr.activate: Read22 91 14,length>=7; if byte6&80 clear, clone entire response, byte0=2E,byte6|=80 and send.
fsrrsr.confirm_loop: Wait200ms; read22 90 35,length>=7. byte6&80 -> flag1 immediately. Otherwise initialize startTime after first valid response, read22 90 32,length>=6; code=byte5&0F. Nonzero -> flag2,String(code). Otherwise elapsed>=10000ms rejects; repeat otherwise.

Process2_mode_transition.controller_aggregate: executeProcess2 resets modeTransitionFlag/errorCode, visits only checked parts in fixed order and returns result=every(flag<=1). Error2 and communication/error3 therefore fail the aggregate. An empty set would pass every(), but the normal S002 UI disables that admission.

frd.status: Read22 90 40,length>=6; adjustmentStatus=byte5. Then22 90 13,length>=6; err=(byte5>>3)&1F. Nonzero -> resultFlag2,errorCode=String(err). With err0, status>6 rejects; status<6 sets defaultSession=false and returns incomplete0; status===6 enters completion loop.
frd.completion_loop: Wait200ms;22 90 11,length>=7. Initialize startTime after first valid response. byte6&20 -> resultFlag1. Otherwise22 90 13,length>=6 and nonzero err -> flag2,String(err). Otherwise elapsed>=10000ms rejects -> flag3. Return badConditionFlag0.

adas.status: Read22 11 06,length>=4; adjustmentStatus=byte3. Then22 11 0A,length>=5. badConditionFlag=(supportBits>>2&1)&(errBits>>2&1). Build supported error codes31..35 from masks80>>index. Nonempty -> resultFlag2,errorCode=joined string. No errors and status>6 rejects; status<6 -> defaultSession=false,incomplete0; status===6 -> completion loop.
adas.completion_loop: Wait200ms;22 11 07,length>=5. Initialize startTime after first valid response. byte4&80 -> resultFlag1. Otherwise22 11 0A,length>=5, rebuild codes31..35; nonempty -> resultFlag2,errorCode=String(joinedString). Otherwise elapsed>=5000ms rejects -> flag3. badConditionFlag is not recomputed in this completion loop.

fsrrsr.status: Read22 90 33,length>=6; adjustmentStatus=byte5&07. Read22 90 32,length>=6; err=byte5&0F. Nonzero -> resultFlag2,String(err). With err0, status>6 rejects; all remaining statuses perform completion reads.
fsrrsr.completion_reads: Read22 90 34,length>=7 and capture byte6&80. Then22 91 12,length>=7. constructor_and_worker_bridge.main_side: Controllers call GtsBaseController, retain commonInfo, create EventDispatcher and ActivityLogger, and instantiate their own model/dialog/view objects at init. Models call GtsBaseModel, retain commonInfo and create their unit WorkerApi. WorkerApi constructs GtsWorkerApi(commonInfo); these model constructors instantiate their WorkerApi without an argument. Its constructor creates commandHandler and null commonInfo/ecuCache/cache/commandThread fields, with buffer and sometimes storedCache fields. init stores the injected references then calls initCommandHandler. Handlers bind the worker method with the worker itself as its first argument. Unit initialization replaces the unit cache. Stored ecuCache/buffer/storedCache fields have no additional business mutation in these six units.
constructor_and_worker_bridge.error_boundary: Some worker chains end in .catch(model.onErrorCommon), and controller/view chains use their shared onErrorCommon. This fragment preserves those calls; shared runtime ownership must resolve callback provision and behavior rather than assuming an implementation in these members.

constructor_and_worker_bridge.dispose: The controllers dispose the current view and their EventDispatcher and resolve. None of their dispose methods directly unregisters the worker, resets a diagnostic session, ends general communication, or stops DCam10's periodic command.

Each controller show-screen method disposes the preceding view if present, constructs the named screen view, awaits initView, and binds precisely that screen's declared events.
fcm_template_lifecycle.load: initView calls ViewUtil.getView(unit/screen.html,'gts_main_panel'), sets the document and screen title, shows title, hides status pane and function buttons, appends the template's v_pane/v_c_pane children, draws resources, installs handlers, triggers window resize, and resolves; its catch invokes view.onErrorCommon.
fcm_template_lifecycle.events: Button handlers take evt.data as the view and trigger the declared event. Values, where present, are passed as the second event argument and are read by controllers as evt.args[1].
fcm_template_lifecycle.dispose: disposeView empties both captured panes, disposes the view dispatcher and hides title. Fcm18 screen03/screen05 additionally register anonymous window resize callbacks but do not explicitly remove those callbacks in their dispose methods.
fcm_template_lifecycle.dialog: Unit dialogs call shared createCommonDialog/createCommonErrorDialog. Confirmation/information buttons use autoClose:true. closeDialog/closeLoaderDialog closes its retained loader if present and nulls that reference. Separate confirmation dialogs are not retained in that loader field.

recorded_precondition_checkbox.admission: Screen001 Next is disabled until the recorded-precondition checkbox is checked. drawViewPane installs the checkbox click callback and toggles Next to the checkbox's current checked state.
recorded_precondition_checkbox.retention: Fcm17, Fcm18 and Fcm20 store isChecked=true on Next and reuse it on return. Fcm21 passes a boolean directly to showSFcm21001; initial false, Back and retry paths true.
recorded_precondition_checkbox.not_a_diagnostic_check: The checkbox gates UI admission only. Its click does not query the ECU.

diagnostic_request_boundary.arguments: All explicit diagnostic message frames in these six units call gts.util.SendMessageForUtility({reqType:0,reqBody:Array}). Byte arrays below are listed in transmission order. No unit locally chooses CAN identifiers or frames transport packets.
diagnostic_request_boundary.shared_response_join: The SendMessageForUtility helper checks echoed DID for 0x22/0x2E and echoed subfunction/RID for 0x31 and supplies normalized rejected objects containing response. The complete helper, PF status interpretation and native transport belong to cross_owner_handoffs.
diagnostic_request_boundary.sessions: startGeneralComm receives {ecuId,busId} obtained from commonInfo.getEcuInfoByEcuId. transitSession receives {modeId:1} for default and {modeId:3} for extended. endGeneralComm is normally called without arguments or with {}, as noted by the individual method bodies.

applies_to_all_six.construction_and_dispatch: Each controller calls GtsBaseController, stores commonInfo, creates EventDispatcher and ActivityLogger, and later constructs its own model/view/dialog. Each model calls GtsBaseModel and constructs its matching WorkerApi without arguments. Each WorkerApi constructs GtsWorkerApi(commonInfo) and returns send(command,param) unchanged. Each worker constructor initializes commandHandler={}, buffer/commonInfo/ecuCache/cache/commandThread/storedCache=null. init stores commonInfo, ecuCache and commandThread, then binds every registered command to its matching method with model as the first argument. Each worker definition and final singleton construction are guarded by !workerController.workerModels['<identity>']. buffer, storedCache, ecuCache and commandThread have no further business use in these members.
applies_to_all_six.wire_command_rule: WorkerApi commands are the literal '<directory>.<method>' strings. Model methods not explicitly parameterized below pass {}. Init methods and parameterized methods are enumerated in each unit. There is no additional frontend transport transformation between model, WorkerApi and worker param.parameter.
applies_to_all_six.view_lifetime: Screen creation disposes the prior workflow view and binds the buttons described below. Workflow View.prototype.initView itself returns Promise.resolve(); create methods synchronously return a newly initialized UtilityView. BACK_TO_UTILITY_MENU is the literal 'backToUtilityMenu' event. backPreviousScreen only emits this event and resolves.
applies_to_all_six.rendering: These workflows load no workflow-specific HTML template. UtilityView builds their Text/TextBox/Table/button DOM programmatically. MessageDialog and LoaderDialog build modal DOM programmatically under #modal_dialog. G001/G003/L002 are renderer types, not HTML paths. Frd09/10 additionally insert saved-date markup into the generated screen/modal DOM.
applies_to_all_six.raw_request_boundary: Every raw request below is gts.util.SendMessageForUtility({reqType:0,reqBody:number[]}). The helper forwards to GtsPFApi.sendMessage/UG000015. For these request modes it validates DID echoes for 22/2E, subfunction plus routine identifier for 31, and subfunction for 3E. Native/protocol/frame interpretation remains a cross-owner join. Worker branches described below are additional workflow checks, not a claim that resolved PF responses imply any unshown numeric result check.
applies_to_all_six.dispose: Frd09, Frd10, Adas01, Adas02 and Adas03 dispose an existing current view conditionally and dispose their controller event dispatcher. Adas04 unconditionally calls controller.view.disposeView(). None of these dispose methods closes a loader, cancels a wait, aborts a worker loop, restores negative-response policy, resets cache, or requests communication/session cleanup.
applies_to_all_six.scope_of_cleanup: No owned member clears DTCs, starts a separate periodic operation, or explicitly restores repReqRetryMax. Session and general-communication cleanup occurs only on the explicit paths below.

adas_session_helpers.start_result: Success resolves {}. Any failure other than the swallowed policy failure calls best-effort endGeneralComm, then rejects {}. It does not first restore default session.
adas_session_helpers.normal_cleanup: transitDefaultSession invokes transitSession({modeId:1}), swallowing failure, then endGeneralComm, swallowing failure, then resolves {}. Adas01/02/03 pass {} to endGeneralComm; Adas04 omits the argument.

camera_restart_helpers.startCameraSensor: Send 31 01 11 A0 immediately. If it resolves, resolve {}. Otherwise perform up to two retry iterations: wait 3000 ms; send 3E 00 and swallow its failure; wait another 3000 ms; retry 31 01 11 A0. First failed retry sets cnt from 0 to 1 and loops; second failed retry stops. Any successful retry resolves {}; exhausted retries reject {}.
camera_restart_helpers.result_check: Adas02.checkCameraSensor and Adas04.checkResultCameraSensor wait 3000 ms, send 31 03 11 A0, require resBody.length>=6 and resBody[5]===2, then resolve {}; all other responses/errors reject {}.
camera_restart_helpers.cancellation: These waits and requests do not inspect the ADAS cancellation flags.

target_read.response: Require resBody.length>=11. Discard three header bytes. Decode targetHeight, targetDistance, distanceBetweenTargets and targetSize from successive unsigned big-endian 16-bit pairs. unit comes from commonInfo.getUnitSetting().distance. For unit===2 convert each millimetre value to Math.round(value*100/25.4)/100. Return each value as a decimal string in {result:{valueList:{targetHeight,targetDistance,distanceBetweenTargets,targetSize,unit}}}. Failures reject {}.

ordered_requests: 22 A1 11; require at least four total response bytes

mapping.1103: After discarding three header bytes, both data bytes must have the same selected bit: 0x80=>11, 0x40=>12, 0x20=>13.
mapping.1104: Both data bytes must have the selected bit: 0x40=>4, 0x10=>5, 0x08=>1, 0x04=>2, 0x02=>3.

diagnostic_error_lists.return: Combine selected codes, sort numerically ascending, map each to String(num).padStart(2,'0'), and resolve {result:{errorCodeList}}. Empty combined list, any request failure or exception rejects {}.
diagnostic_error_lists.important_non_equivalence: Adas02 requires only four total bytes for the 1103/1104 responses, although its bit checks access two payload bytes. Adas03 requires five total bytes for both responses. Do not merge these admission guards.

cancel_protocol.initial_state: Controller cancelClickedFlag=false and abortedFlag=false; worker cache isCancelClicked=false and isAborted=false. Init resets these fields. Screen-only retry does not reinitialize them.
cancel_protocol.cancel_click: Set controller.cancelClickedFlag=true; dispatch setIsCancelClicked(true) without awaiting it; close the active loader; display cancellation confirmation.
cancel_protocol.confirm_yes: Set cancelClickedFlag=false and abortedFlag=true; show the buttonless loader; dispatch setIsAborted(true) and setIsCancelClicked(false) without awaiting them.
cancel_protocol.confirm_no: Reopen the cancellable loader, set cancelClickedFlag=false, and dispatch setIsCancelClicked(false) without awaiting it.
cancel_protocol.worker_semantics: setIsAborted and setIsCancelClicked assign the corresponding cache field and resolve {}. Polling loops inspect isAborted before each iteration and reject their typed ABORTED error. No worker branch reads isCancelClicked; it is stored only. Cancel does not issue a routine-stop request.
cancel_protocol.controller_completion_barrier: After certain already-completed worker operations, controller code waits in 100-ms waits while cancelClickedFlag is true. Confirmed abort then performs default-session/general-communication cleanup and emits backToUtilityMenu instead of presenting the completed result. Exact Adas02 and Adas03 promise shapes differ and are preserved below.

owned_construction_dispatch.construction: Each controller invokes GtsBaseController, stores commonInfo, allocates its event dispatcher and ActivityLogger, and initializes its model/view/dialog references. Each model invokes GtsBaseModel and constructs its named WorkerApi without passing commonInfo. Each WorkerApi constructs GtsWorkerApi(commonInfo). Views invoke UtilityView; dialogs invoke GtsBaseView and construct a dispatcher. All subclass prototype links are installed with Object.setPrototypeOf.
owned_construction_dispatch.worker_lifetime: Each worker is defined and instantiated only if workerController.workerModels[implementationIdentity] is falsy. Its init stores commonInfo, ecuCache and commandThread and initializes commandHandler. Every command handler binds the worker method with both this and its first model argument fixed to that worker.
owned_construction_dispatch.worker_state: All workers initialize commandHandler/commonInfo/ecuCache/cache/commandThread. Adas09/10/12 and Fsrrsr01/02 additionally initialize buffer and storedCache to null; these fields have no further behavior in their owned members.
owned_construction_dispatch.transport: WorkerApi methods return GtsWorkerApi.send(command,param) unchanged. Command names are <directory>.<method>. Models pass {} for methods without workflow arguments. Workers consume arguments under param.parameter. No owned API wrapper retries, transforms returned results, or introduces another error mapping.
owned_construction_dispatch.view_lifetime: Every transition to a new owned screen disposes the previous currentView/view before creating and binding the replacement. Each View.initView override simply returns Promise.resolve(); actual screen methods instantiate a fresh UtilityView and synchronously return its initView result.
owned_construction_dispatch.exit: All backPreviousScreen methods trigger BACK_TO_UTILITY_MENU='backToUtilityMenu' and resolve. This is an event continuation to the utility-menu owner, not an ECU operation.
owned_construction_dispatch.scope_of_dispose: Controllers dispose their current screen and event dispatcher only. They do not cancel in-flight worker requests, clear a worker cache, close communication or issue a routine stop from dispose. Frd07.dispose dereferences currentView without a null guard; the other five check for an existing screen.
owned_construction_dispatch.inherited_errors: init promise chains and Fsrrsr main-action chains that call controller.onErrorCommon retain the shared GtsBaseController error handoff; its presentation is owned by MenuShell.

ordered_steps: Resolve {} without ending communication; subsequent worker methods use the admitted communication context.
adas_extended_session.admission_failure: Attempt SC000014 endGeneralComm({}), swallow its rejection, then reject the workflow-specific session-admission error.
adas_extended_session.normal_cleanup: transitDefaultSession performs UG000004({modeId:1}), swallowing failure, then SC000014({}), swallowing failure, then resolves {}.
adas_extended_session.not_performed: No explicit keepalive start/stop, DTC read/clear or periodic-message operation is present.

adas_image_setting.entry_domain: Current ECU selected by commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId(); worker resolves that ID through getEcuInfoByEcuId. Screen text asks the operator to satisfy stopped/ignition/elapsed-time conditions; frontend does not measure or programmatically validate them.
ordered_read: UG000005 requestSecurityAccess({level:3,logId:13}); no key, seed or receiveAck argument is supplied.
Require response.apiArgs.resBody.length >= 5. isActivated is true exactly when response byte[4] bit7 is clear.
Cache every response byte from index3 onward, including bytes not interpreted by this frontend.
Return {result:{isActivated:boolean}}, restore default session/end communication, close loader, display setting screen.
adas_image_setting.selection_screen: R001 contains the current-state text, two radios and Back/Next/Exit. Next is initially enabled and uses useParam:true. If currently activated, deactivate is checked and activate is disabled; if currently deactivated, activate is checked and deactivate is disabled. Thus the offered operation is the opposite of the current state. The active-state text is inserted in a span with the workflow border class.
adas_image_setting.input_binding: Shared R001 button code emits checked radios as {domId,group,value}, with value a string from jQuery.val(). Owned controller selects evt.args[1][0].value without additional validation.
ordered_write: Log the selected operation with the workflow-specific activity prefix.
Show loader, admit extended session and request the same security access again.
Clone the cached DID data. For value '0', clear bit7 of cloned data[1]; for value '1', set bit7. An unrecognized value leaves data unchanged.
Send {reqType:0,reqBody:[0x2E,DID-high,DID-low,...modifiedData]}. All other cached bytes are preserved.
Reread the DID and use the reread state, not the chosen operation, as the displayed result.
Restore default session/end communication, log reread result, close loader and display completion.
adas_image_setting.ui_errors: Read-path failures close the loader and show the shared communication-error dialog, leaving the first screen. Write-path failures close the loader, show that dialog, then recreate the first screen. Session-admission errors do not call transitDefaultSession because admission already ended communication; all other mapped errors call it.
adas_image_setting.navigation: Back from selection recreates the first screen without another ECU request. Exit from first or selection opens an auto-closing Yes/No confirmation: Yes returns to utility menu, No stays. Completion Exit returns directly. No write rollback is issued on errors or navigation.
adas_image_setting.dialogs: Dialog constructors define empty ViewEvent and loader-button objects plus Yes/No constants. Loader is created only if absent and closeLoaderDialog closes and nulls it. Confirmations always create a fresh common dialog.
adas_image_setting.native_boundary: Frontend handles fulfilled/rejected security promises only and discards security result fields. Seed/key generation, security policy and native session mechanics remain separate-owner joins.

fsrrsr_shared_radar_management.equivalence_basis: Both complete workers were read. After implementation-name normalization, initialization, checkEcus, radar stop operations, cleanup and restartRadars are equivalent. Differences are the main operation names, target start/poll frames, result conversion and associated UI/activity resources, explicitly mapped below.

entry_domain.selection: gts.util.getEcuId scans target candidate IDs in order, then mounted ECUs; first exact matching ecuId wins. There is no numeric coercion. Missing candidates remain undefined.
entry_domain.target_selection: Worker targetSideRdIdx starts at 0 and changes only when a resolved side slot has ecuInfo.ecuId === currEcuId. No explicit admission check rejects a missing target or a current ID outside the four side slots.

fsrrsr_shared_radar_management.initialization: Resolve supplied existing front/side IDs to ECU-info objects, retain target slot match, install cache and resolve {result:true}. Missing IDs are skipped. This initialization does not establish connectivity.
ordered_checkEcus: If front ECU-info exists, call getEcuStatus({checkConnected:true,checkEcuFuncList:true}); CONNECTED marks front available. Rejection is swallowed.
Visit side slots in order, skipping targetSideRdIdx and slots without ECU-info.
Call the same status request. CONNECTED marks the slot available and increments sideRdConnCnt; rejection is swallowed.

For each available non-target side radar: startGeneralComm({ecuId,busId}), setNegativeResponseCondition({repReqRetryMax:0}) with swallowed failure, transitSession({modeId:1}), transitSession({modeId:3}).
After extended-session success, send 22 A1 91 and require length>=6 and (resBody[5]&0x04)===0x04; then send 22 91 15 and require length>=6 and (resBody[5]&0x80)===0x80.
Finally, restore mode1 only if extended session was entered; always endGeneralComm(), with both cleanup failures swallowed.
Any support/session failure resolves {result:false}; otherwise resolve {result:true}. Target connectivity and support are not checked by this method.
ordered_stop_and_execute: Stop the front radar if available, using the per-ECU session sequence and cleanup described above.

Front stop: read 22 AA 04, require length>=5 and save the complete response. If response[4] bit0x20 is clear, copy the complete saved response to reqBody, replace reqBody[0] with 0x2E, set reqBody[4]|=0x20, send it, reread 22 AA 04 and require that bit set. If already set, do not write/reread.
Only after front-stop completion, set isRequiredFunc100=true, even if no front radar was available.
Stop available non-target side radars in slot order. If sideRdConnCnt<=0, skip this loop.

Side stop: read 22 91 15, require length>=7 and save the complete response. If response[6] bit0x80 is clear, copy the complete response, replace reqBody[0] with 0x2E, set reqBody[6]|=0x80, send it, reread and require that bit set. If already set, do not write/reread.
For each stopped radar, restore mode1 only after successful entry to extended session, then always end communication. Stop failures reject the current chain.
Start communication with target side slot, enter default then extended session, send the unit-specific routine-start frame and require response length>=5.
Poll the unit-specific DID immediately and recursively, without an inserted wait. Require response length>=7. Return success indicator when response[6]&0x80 is set.
For the first valid not-complete poll, record Date.now(). Continue recursive polls until complete or elapsed time>=4000ms; timeout returns the last byte rather than directly rejecting.

If final completion bit is clear, read 22 90 32. Any fulfilled response sets cache.hasReadErrCd=true and isShowDl003=false. If length>=6 and low nibble of response[5] is nonzero, set errCd=response[5]&0x0F and isTransit004=true. This helper always rejects afterward. A rejected read leaves isShowDl003=true and hasReadErrCd=false.

If complete, read 22 90 30 and perform the unit-specific conversion. Successful conversion sets isShowDl003=false and resolves a main result with result:true. Any earlier failure resolves result:false with the accumulated flags.
Target finally restores mode1 only if extended-session entry succeeded, then always ends communication; cleanup failures are swallowed.
ordered_restart: Controller calls restartRadars only when mainResult.isRequiredFunc100 is true.
Visit available front first, then every available non-target side radar in slot order.
Each uses startGeneralComm, negative-response configuration with swallowed error, mode1, mode3 and per-ECU finally cleanup.
Front: read 22 AA 04 length>=5; if bit0x20 is set, copy the complete response, set first byte to 0x2E, clear reqBody[4] with &=0xDF, send, reread and require the bit clear.
Side: read 22 91 15 length>=7; if bit0x80 is set, copy the complete response, set first byte to 0x2E, clear reqBody[6] with &=0x7F, send, reread and require the bit clear.
A per-radar restart failure sets isRestartError=1 but resolves locally, allowing remaining radars to be attempted.

After all attempts, return {result:false} exactly when isRestartError!==0 && !cache.hasReadErrCd; otherwise return {result:true}. A fulfilled error-code read therefore suppresses the reported restart failure, even when it supplied no displayable code.
controller_result_precedence: Open loader and await the main action.
If required, await restart. A false restart result closes loader and shows DL004, overriding the main result presentation.
Otherwise close loader and judge main result.
For result:false, show DL003 if isShowDl003; otherwise display/log the error-code screen if isTransit004; otherwise show shared communication error.
For result:true, log the unit-specific retained table and display the success table.
fsrrsr_shared_radar_management.mutation_cleanup_limits: All requests use reqType:0. Radar stop/restart writes preserve the full saved response except service byte and named mask. A front-stop failure occurs before isRequiredFunc100 is set, so controller does not run restart in that case, including failures after a front write but before successful verification. No in-flight Cancel, routine-stop frame, DTC operation or explicit keepalive operation is implemented.
fsrrsr_shared_radar_management.ui_navigation: Initial display is an empty no-button screen plus loader while checkEcus runs. Failed check closes loader, shows communication error, then returns to menu. Main screen has Next and Exit only. Exit confirmation DL002 returns on Yes and stays for every other ID. DL003/DL004 return on No; every other ID stays on the current main screen, allowing the operator to press Next again. Success and error-code screens have direct Exit. All dialogs have auto-closing Yes/No buttons except the no-button loader.
fsrrsr_shared_radar_management.dialog_lifetime: createDl001 always creates and stores a fresh dlg rather than checking for an existing one. closeDialog closes and nulls that stored dialog.

applies_to_all_six.construction_and_dispatch: Each controller calls GtsBaseController, retains commonInfo, constructs its own EventDispatcher and ActivityLogger, and later constructs the unit model/view/dialog. Each model calls GtsBaseModel and constructs its unit WorkerApi. Each WorkerApi constructs GtsWorkerApi and returns its send(command,param) promise unchanged. Each worker is instantiated only inside if(!workerController.workerModels['ImplementationIdentity']); worker init stores commonInfo, ecuCache and commandThread and calls initCommandHandler. Every listed command is bound with the worker model supplied as its first argument. Constructor fields buffer, storedCache and initially null cache are not additional workflow operations.
applies_to_all_six.wire_parameter_boundary: Worker command arguments arrive under param.parameter. Models create only the explicitly described parameter objects; WorkerApi adds no payload transformation or response mapping.
applies_to_all_six.views: All six workflows generate their UI through UtilityView and inline DOM; none of their 36 source members loads an external HTML template. G001/G002/L002/C001 are UtilityView type identifiers, not filenames. Every unit view's initView method simply returns Promise.resolve(). Each controller show-screen method disposes an existing unit screen, constructs the named replacement and attaches the listed events. backPreviousScreen triggers backToUtilityMenu and resolves; it does not itself stop communication.
applies_to_all_six.dispose: Controller dispose disposes the current unit view and its EventDispatcher only. Fsrrsr03/Fsrrsr04/Adas05 guard absent views; Adas06/Adas08/Frd11 directly invoke currentView.disposeView(). None adds native session, DTC, periodic-message, keepalive or polling cancellation during dispose.
applies_to_all_six.raw_message_boundary: Every workflow diagnostic message described below is passed as {reqType:0,reqBody:byteArray} to gts.util.SendMessageForUtility. For services used here, the shared helper checks DID echo for 22/2E and subfunction plus routine identifier echo for 31. On rejected PF messages it maps absent resBody to OTHER_ERROR, empty resBody to NO_RESPONSE, 7F responses to NEGATIVE_RESPONSE, including NRC21->BUSY_REPEAT_REQUEST and NRC24->REQUEST_SEQUENCE_ERROR. The workflows' additional length/result/bit checks remain specified separately.
applies_to_all_six.timing: All timing here uses awaited gts.util.wait calls; these members do not create setTimeout/setInterval handles or implement timer-handle clearing.
applies_to_all_six.native_continuation: The frontend continuation is WorkerApi command -> bound worker method -> GtsPFApi or SendMessageForUtility -> PF/native/cassette owner. These members do not implement a native ECU algorithm or select a cassette directly.

adas_06.isInitializingUltrasonicSensor: WorkerApi send receives no parameter argument.

fsrrsr_file_identity.folder_resolution: getSpecificFolder({folderNo:1}) must resolve with resultInfo.result===0, a defined nonempty folderInfoList and nonempty first folderInfo. Then getSettingFileInfo({fileType:2,keyList:['specificSubFolders','utilityStoreData']}) must have resultInfo.result===0 and fileData exactly '\MemG'; append fileData to the cached folderInfo. No directory creation is requested.
fsrrsr_file_identity.file_time: getFolderInformation({path:folderInfo,includeFileList:[savedFileName]}) supplies fileInfoList[0].lastUpdate. Construct Date, reject NaN, extract local year/month+1/day/hour/minute/second and pass that object to gts.util.convertLocaleTime. No timestamp is stored inside the saved payload.

common_contracts.scope: The following equivalences were observed in all six complete source sets; workflow-specific exceptions are stated below.
construction_and_dispatch: Each controller calls GtsBaseController, retains commonInfo, constructs EventDispatcher and ActivityLogger, and initially has null model/dialog/view references.
Each model calls GtsBaseModel, retains commonInfo, and constructs its workflow WorkerApi without arguments.
Each WorkerApi constructs GtsWorkerApi(commonInfo). Its methods return send(command,param) unchanged. Commands are the workflow directory name plus '.' plus the worker method name.

Each worker is registered only inside if(!workerController.workerModels['ImplementationIdentity']). Its init(commonInfo,ecuCache,commandThread) retains those arguments and registers every command with method.bind(model,model). Command arguments are read through param.parameter.

Worker constructors initialize commandHandler={}, commonInfo/ecuCache/cache/commandThread=null. A07/A13/A15/A16/A14 additionally initialize buffer/storedCache=null. Those extra fields are not used by these workflows.
Model methods return the corresponding API promise; ordinary no-input operations pass {}. Exceptional payloads and sequencing are specified below.
All backPreviousScreen implementations trigger 'backToUtilityMenu' and resolve; they do not independently perform ECU cleanup.
Screen replacement disposes the preceding screen before constructing and binding the next. Controller dispose releases screen/event-dispatcher UI state only, not communication/session state.

transport.request_type: Every listed raw diagnostic request is passed as {reqType:0,reqBody:[bytes...]} to gts.util.SendMessageForUtility.
transport.response_type: Successful utility-message results expose response.apiArgs.resBody. Request/body arrays are ordinary numeric JS arrays.
transport.shared_validation: shell.SendMessageForUtility additionally checks 0x19 subfunction, 0x22/0x2E DID bytes, and 0x31 subfunction/RID echo. Its rejection is preserved into each workflow's own mapping. These frontend methods do not independently prove native/protocol success beyond their stated checks.
transport.session_arguments: startGeneralComm({ecuId,busId}); setNegativeResponseCondition({repReqRetryMax:0}); transitSession({modeId:1}) for default and {modeId:3} for extended. Negative-response-condition setting failures are deliberately swallowed in every inspected setup.
transport.security: Adas13/15/16/14 call requestSecurityAccess({level:0x03,logId:13}) after entering extended session; no key/seed algorithm is implemented by these workflow sources.

ui_event_boundary.typed_results: UtilityView useParam G003 emits text inputs as [{domId,value}], R001 emits checked radio inputs as [{domId,group,value}]; these controllers consume evt.args[1][0].value. Standard button events are Next=1, Back=2, Exit=3, OK=4, Cancel=5, Yes=6, No=7.
ui_event_boundary.dialogs: Each listed confirmation button has autoClose:true. Loader dialogs have no buttons. Close methods close retained loader/dlg objects only if present and clear their retained reference.
ui_event_boundary.cleanup: A07/F08/A16/A14 dispose currentView without a null guard. A13/A15 guard their view. Dialog constructors call GtsBaseView and create EventDispatcher; they do not perform ECU operations.

runtime_inputs_not_supplied: The selected vehicle's current commonInfo ECU/bus catalog and actual diagnostic response bodies.
Fcm18 runtime sendCalibrationResult setting object, translated-string responses, dealer/VIN/mileage/session values and live web response.
DCam10 runtime custom-list/signal metadata, signal values, support bitmaps, configured specific-folder path and native file-write response.
AdasFcmLater.interpretation: These are concrete runtime domains consumed by fully described branches, not claims that source semantics are missing. Native implementation algorithms, selected transport/cassette continuation and shared framework behavior are intentionally cross-owner contracts.

AdasCalibrations.input: Current session's commonInfo/current ECU and mounted ECU records
AdasCalibrations.effect: Determines selected ecuId,busId and ECU-status admission. These are runtime inputs; no vehicle/session action was performed to obtain them.

AdasCalibrations.input: Runtime PF diagnostic responses for the enumerated DIDs/routines
AdasCalibrations.effect: Actual support bitmap, status bytes, ECU error codes and success/failure outcomes remain unobserved. Frontend mapping for each supplied response domain is specified above.

AdasCalibrations.input: Runtime specific-folder/settings/file metadata and saved file contents
AdasCalibrations.effect: Absolute storage path,lastUpdate and ciphertext/plaintext contents were not read through application services; exact filename,folder-key,serialization,decryption and restore-byte contracts are available from source.

AdasCalibrations.input: Runtime distributor sendCalibrationResult setting,loginMode,dealer information,VIN,mileage,unit setting and server response
AdasCalibrations.effect: Concrete endpoint/serverId/body values and logout/upload outcome are not asserted. Exact parsing,admission,payload and response branches are closed from authenticated source.
